text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the intense summer training camp over, Vivlos—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Mom, Dad~!
Can you give Trainy some meat?

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Here you go!
Trainer, hand me the plate over here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was having a barbecue with her family.
They had been supporting us throughout the training camp,
which was a tremendous help, but...
choice_data_list: (Is it really okay to be doing this...?)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Father prepared the finest meat just for this occasion.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Please, help yourself without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Trainy,
is it tasty?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~.
So cute~â¡

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
The way you look so happy
when you're munching away.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Vivlos-chan really has taken quite a liking to you, Trainer~

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san~,
could you serve this plate over here?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer,
you've really blended right in, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Told you, didn't I?
We're already family, after all~!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...Whoops, huh?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Cheva-chiii!
What's up, aren't you eating anything at all?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay
to do something like this...?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: I made sure to get permission, you know?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
That's not it...
...Never mind.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...How was
the training camp?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Like, your physical condition, you know?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
It feels super good!
I worked super hard with Trainy, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "Back in my Classic Year, my body wasn't quite ready for it yet, so I ended up collapsing, but..."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
She seems to have pulled it together now!
Looks like we can aim for Dubai next year♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Where's Cheva-chi?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...You're getting stronger.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
!
I see.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still... Kita-san is running, after all.
I feel like I'm still not ready.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I plan to hone myself even further
by the time the big day arrives.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, then
I'll work even harder too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Don't you think that if the two of us push each other,
we can become stronger than either of us could alone?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"Right!
I can't wait for the race!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so,
our third year's summer training camp came to a lively end.
